4 احصل النَّخْلُ ; (S, K;) and ↓ حصّل , inf. n. تَحْصِيلٌ; (K;) The palm-trees had حَصَل; i. e., dates that had not yet become hard, (S, K,) and of which the ثَفَارِيق [or bases] had not yet appeared; (S;) or dates that had become hard and round: and also, had حَصَل as meaning spadixes (طَلْع) that had become yellow: (K:) or احصل البَلَحُ the dates came forth from their ثفاريق, small: and ↓ حصّل they became round. (TA.) ―
-b2- احصل القَوْمُ The people had unripe, or ripening, dates appearing upon their palm-trees. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
